prompt: service worker FetchEvent replacesClientId engine implementation status
answer:
`FetchEvent.replacesClientId` is currently **not implemented in any engine**. The Service Workers specification states: “In no current engines.” ([W3C](https://www.w3.org/TR/service-workers))

Supporting status information:

- Mozilla has an open implementation bug: [Bug 1487534](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1487534).
- WebKit has an implementation bug: [WebKit Bug 226638](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=226638).
- MDN’s compatibility data was removed because the feature had been removed from all browsers for at least two years. ([MDN issue #42195](https://github.com/mdn/content/issues/42195), [BCD issue #28556](https://github.com/mdn/browser-compat-data/issues/28556))
